dct_title_s: Stanford's map of central & eastern Europe : showing the international frontiers
dct_description_sm: Indicates railways, roads, canals, submarine telegraph lines, and fortresses.
Relief shown by hachures and spot heights.
Also available on the Internet through the American Geographical Society Library Digital Map Collection.
